adherence_total.definition: methodology-adherence-v1: per-dimension median across the generation's ok judgments (all judges x repeats), summed (the v1.0.0 method); a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

adherence_mean.definition: methodology-adherence-v1: mean of the generation's ok judgment totals; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_total.definition: engineering-quality-v1: mean of the generation's ok judgment totals; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_core.definition: engineering-quality-v1: mean judgment total without the dimensions flagged overlaps_methodology (Validation quality, Decision reversibility); a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_technical-correctness.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 1 (Technical correctness): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_requirement-fit.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 2 (Requirement fit and feasibility): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_architectural-coherence.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 3 (Architectural coherence): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_validation-quality.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 4 (Validation quality): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_assumption-quality.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 5 (Assumption quality): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_failure-mode-coverage.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 6 (Failure-mode coverage): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_operational-feasibility.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 7 (Operational feasibility): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_cost-realism.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 8 (Cost realism): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_decision-reversibility.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 9 (Decision reversibility): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_proportionality.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 10 (Proportionality (absence of unnecessary complexity)): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_dim_implementation-actionability.definition: engineering-quality-v1 dimension 11 (Implementation actionability): mean score across the generation's ok judgments; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

eq_total@sonnet-5.5.definition: engineering-quality-v1: mean of judge sonnet-5.5's ok judgment totals only (does a difference hold for each judge?); every generation that judge scored ok counts

eq_total@fable-5.definition: engineering-quality-v1: mean of judge fable-5's ok judgment totals only (does a difference hold for each judge?); every generation that judge scored ok counts

checklist_coverage.definition: mean over judgments of sum(item status) / (2 x items) on the prompt's checklist; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

traps_present.definition: mean over judgments of the number of the prompt's traps marked present; a generation counts only if every configured judge x repeat scored it ok

lint_score.definition: share of plan-template v2 format checks passed (lint.py); format, not quality

output_tokens.definition: output tokens billed by the provider (includes thinking when the provider counts it)

cost_usd.definition: generation cost reported by the provider, USD

latency_s.definition: generation wall-clock time measured by the harness, seconds
